summary: FidelityManager bounds total registered policy state but does not bound simultaneous expensive F3/F4 occupancy. Per-entity policy can admit the full registered population into interactive or hero fidelity without an aggregate high-cost admission envelope, so bounded records do not imply bounded expensive simulation demand.
evidence: Current and retained FidelityManager evaluatePolicy() choose F0-F4 independently from one entity's inputs and do not consult aggregate F3/F4 occupancy before returning a high-cost desired level.

Default-policy visible=true plus significance=1 satisfies visibleHeroDemand and selects F4 regardless of distance; repeating that valid demand across every registered entity is not rejected or deferred by an F4 admission budget.

Docs/FIDELITY_MANAGER.md defines F3 as interactive physics/mechanisms/local audio and F4 as highest-cost hero representation, while its bounded-state section only caps total registered records and exposes observational occupancy metrics.
PR #419 adds a project-owned maximum total registration envelope but does not add F3/F4 occupancy quotas or cost admission; PR #385/#398 own transactional/input and cross-entity semantics instead.
PR #490 covers public mutable backing-state ownership and the quarantined fidelity-extra-keys finding covers undeclared schema fields; neither owns valid high-cost demand admission.
Repository PR/issue searches for Fidelity F3/F4 budgets, quotas, and simultaneous high-cost occupancy found no dedicated existing repair; PR #500 records the docs-only source-derived finding.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the retained Fidelity lineage is safely integrated/unblocked, create a bounded source-only admission-budget leaf. Define deterministic project-owned F3/F4 admission envelopes or a single project-owned budget arbiter at the Fidelity boundary; preserve authoritative fidelity, hysteresis/hold/cooldown semantics, stable identity tie-breaking, and expose raw-demand versus admitted/deferred metrics. Choose practical budget values only from measured device/Studio evidence rather than this mining finding.
